energy_kwh.definition: Modeled whole-cluster energy, including sleep and wake power.

mean_active_hosts.definition: Time-weighted powered hosts, including waking hosts.

mean_wait_s.definition: Instance-weighted initial wait, including queueing and wake delay.

migration_pause_instance_seconds.definition: Sum of instance pauses, including destination wake delay.

overload_host_time_fraction.definition: Modeled SLA proxy: CPU-or-memory reservation pressure above the configured threshold; not measured SLA violations.

p95_turnaround_s.definition: Within-run 95th percentile of completion minus release.

p95_wait_s.definition: Within-run 95th percentile; never average across runs or categories.

peak_active_hosts.definition: Maximum number of powered hosts, including waking hosts.

queue_instance_seconds.definition: Queue time before dispatch, excluding subsequent wake delay.

rejected_instances.definition: Offered instances rejected by the simulator.

stop_time_s.definition: Maximum of arrival horizon and final completion.

unfinished_instances.definition: Arrived instances neither completed nor rejected at the stopping rule.

wh_per_completed_instance.definition: 1000 * energy_kwh / completed_instances; not per task group.

artifacts.title: D5 placement decisions

artifacts.caption: Existing D5 analysis, restricted to the active study. Energy change in D5 means candidate minus baseline; positive indicates a penalty, unlike energy reduction.

limitations: Deterministic simulation grid; no statistical replications or confidence intervals.
SPECpower curves are separate surrogate sensitivity cases, not Alibaba hardware calibration.
Reservation pressure is a modeled overload/SLA proxy, not measured application SLA violations.
Three historical metadata hash discrepancies remain unresolved.
Kafka measurements describe one ARM64 laptop and one broker, not scheduler execution or distributed scalability.

metric_definitions.comparison_scope: Identical workload size, SPECpower curve, simulation config and input-manifest reference.

energy_reduction_pct.definition: 100 * (baseline energy - candidate energy) / baseline energy; positive saves energy.

metric_definitions.missing_values: JSON null / empty CSV field; no imputation.
metric_definitions.percentiles: Never averaged or pooled from summary percentiles.

delayed_pct.definition: Category instances with positive initial wait.

instances.definition: Observed category count; an absent category has no outcome row.

mean_wait_s.definition: Instance-weighted initial wait, including queueing and wake delay.

migrated_pct.definition: Category instances migrated at least once; not migration count.

p95_wait_s.definition: Within-run 95th percentile; never average across runs or categories.

placed_on_asleep_or_waking_server_pct.definition: Category placements on asleep or waking hosts.

metric_definitions.resource_skew_scope: D5 primary LR-MMT pair only; no category energy allocation.
